tess_csm: VerdantAI renewal in 7 weeks. They love the product but called out rising inference spend and occasional p95 spikes during nightly batch runs. Proposing a short experiment: 10% canary to m-verdant-v1:int8 + route low-priority batch indexing to m-small to free capacity. Need engineering + SRE sign-off.

ben_cs: They'll want clear numbers and a rollback SLA. Can we say % savings and rollback within 30 minutes? Also log in Gainsight.

li_engineer: Quick baseline from last 72h: p50 170ms, p95 540ms, tail bursts ~1.3s when concurrency >90. Current unit cost ~ $450/1M tokens. Int8 quant expected ~33% compute savings; median latency +20ms but higher throughput should cut queue time. I'll run regression on their 120-sample set. Suggest 48h @10% canary with automated similarity and error checks + manual spot reviews.

zara_sre: Infra notes: bump min replicas for canary pool, enable prefix caching for repeated contexts, and short-term routing rule: embeddings & bulk indexing -> m-small. I'll set alert: p95 > 800ms OR error_rate > 0.5% -> immediate rollback.

li_engineer: Canary deploy snippet: ```bash
redwoodctl deploy --customer verdantai --model m-verdant-v1:int8 --route canary --weight 0.10 --tag vdt-canary-2026-03
```

deploy-bot: Canary initiated (id: vd-canary-330). Weight: 10%. Region: us-west-2.

tess_csm: Action items: li -> regression + diffs (ETA 8h). zara -> confirm infra & alerts (ETA 2h). ben -> Gainsight note + customer message (ETA 4h). Draft customer line: "We propose a 48h canary to evaluate a quantized variant for cost savings; we will monitor quality closely and roll back within 30 minutes if thresholds breach."

ben_cs: Good. I'll add estimated savings and link to the renewal pack. Will also request a 150-example eval set from VerdantAI.

zara_sre: Alerts live and min replicas bumped. Will monitor closely.

li_engineer: Starting local regression run now. Early pass: 110/120, avg_similarity 0.981, small formatting deltas on long tables.

tess_csm: Thanks team. We'll check back at 24h. :raised_hands:
